summary: Rumble Inc. (now RUM Group Inc.) filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its business combination with Northern Data AG, a German stock corporation, on June 17, 2026. Concurrently, Rumble entered into a secured Credit Agreement with Tether Investments, involving a pre-funded warrant for 50% of Tether's receivable under an existing floating rate loan to Northern Data, and converting the remaining 50% into a credit agreement with a newly formed Irish subsidiary. The deal implies Rumble's acquisition of Northern Data, with Tether as a key counterparty. Terms include a secured credit facility; no price per share, premium, or advisor named. Watch integration and regulatory approvals.
